description: Party Limit Begone compatibility test. P1 — 40K+ endorsements, tests entity manipulation.
assertions: assert((function() for _,u in ipairs(Ext.Mod.GetLoadOrder()) do if u == '991c9c7a-fb80-40cb-8f0d-b92d4e80e9b1' then return true end end return false end)(), 'Party Limit Begone Gustav-override module present in load order (PLB masquerades as Gustav by design)')

assert((function() local entities=Ext.Entity.GetAllEntitiesWithComponent('eoc::character::CharacterComponent'); return type(entities) == 'table' and #entities > 0 end)(), 'loaded-save character entity query executes')
assert((function() local id=Ext.Events.Tick:Subscribe(function() end); local ok=type(id) == 'number'; Ext.Events.Tick:Unsubscribe(id); return ok end)(), 'Tick event subscribe roundtrip executes')
notes: Party Limit Begone increases party to 16 and MP to 8. Tests entity system under load.
